# Android Stats court swiping

Swipe left on Stats for the next court and right for the previous court. Court 4 wraps to Court 1, and Court 1 wraps to Court 4. Court buttons remain available. Stats selection stays local and does not change the Backend or Telestrator court. Vertical scrolling and pinch gestures remain native. Singles/doubles behavior is unchanged.

Validated: full bundled UI swipe integration tests, existing Stats/navigation/interaction/native lifecycle regressions, Java build, original Android signing certificate and packaged asset checks. Physical tablet swipe and scrolling acceptance remains to be tested. The browser native-touch smoke test could not run because the build environment blocked Chromium socket creation.

Android-only release; iPad and Backend packages are unchanged.
